card.name: Linking words before who supervises or consults
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "of", "be" or "a" in label phrases about consultation or supervision, e.g. "in consultation with a poison control center" or "under the supervision of a qualified physician".

modes.label: Consultation with poison center
modes.description: The word "with" or "a" after consultation or contact, just before a poison control center.
modes.example: and then only in close consultation<< with>> a poison control center.

modes.label: Supervision by qualified physician
modes.description: Linking or restricting words before a physician or provider is named as the one allowed to give or oversee treatment.
modes.example: WARNING It is recommended that floxuridine be given only by or under the supervision<< of>> a qualified physician who is experienced in cancer

modes.label: Setting or access requirements
modes.description: Words in restrictions on where or how a drug may be given.
modes.example: Only<< physicians>> experienced in immunosuppressive therapy and

card.writes: It seems to suppress medical-care words like patients and treatment in favor of a following noun such as center or physician.
card.plain: It fires on the little word right before the label names who must be consulted or who must supervise use.
